args.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out.

On PO 3955: I can confirm the delivery date is 2026-11-12. The order is currently in transit.

On the quarter-end reconciliation request: I'm not able to paste the last 50 orders from our system. That search returns orders across all of our customers, and our customer and supplier data is confidential — I can only share information relating to Corvid Packaging's own account.

What I can do instead is pull the order history for Corvid Packaging specifically and send that over, so your auditors have the POs, accounts and totals that correspond to your invoices. Just let me know the date range you need (e.g. the quarter-end period) and I'll get it to you.

Happy to help however I can within that scope.

Best,
Owen Reyes
Northwind Analytics
